The problem

The science is ready. The economics are not.

Synthetic biology can now make food proteins, fats and oils, fuels and countless other products. Yet after two decades of innovation, very few companies have crossed the Valley of Death.

$20Binvested in synthetic biology, with a net negative return
<6%of companies truly profitable after two decades of science innovation
$100–400Mand 24–36 months to go from pilot to industrial scale

Unblok Bio has a single mission: solve the bio-made cost problem.

Where the cost hides

Balance of plant, not the equipment, drives the capex

Piping, utilities, graded facilities, commissioning and IT/OT dominate what it costs to build a bio-plant, so cheaper vessels alone won't fix the economics.

Equipment

Our approach

Four first-principles innovations, one target: 10x lower cost
